note: config/hive-skills.json documents that AIMS's skill catalogue (S001-S2xx) is centralised in the
'hive-skills' R2 bucket with execution_owner: HIVE — i.e. HIVE, not AIMS, is the runtime owner
and executor of that canonical skill registry. The newsletter engine specification requires the
implementation to remain completely independent of HIVE at runtime, which rules out AIMS calling
back into HIVE (or its R2 skill registry) to execute S094 live.
This file is therefore NOT a copy of the canonical S094 definition and does not attempt to be one
— AIMS has no read access to the canonical document from this change, and guessing at its contents
would misrepresent HIVE-owned material. Instead, this is a local record of what AIMS built,
expressed in S094's terms, so that whoever next updates HIVE's central skill index can reconcile
the two deliberately rather than by accident.
Concretely: services/newsletter/* is a native AIMS implementation (not a call-out to HIVE) of the
newsletter-composer capability, extended for a second, config-driven use case (multiple newsletter
profiles) and a documented-API-only Brevo delivery layer.
Action for a future HIVE-side change: bump S094 in the central registry to reference this AIMS
capability (engine version below) if/when HIVE's skill index is updated to describe AIMS-hosted
capabilities. That is out of scope here because it requires HIVE repository access.
Delivery uses Brevo's documented v3 API for campaign creation and immediate sending. AIMS creates/manages the Brevo list itself; scheduling remains owned entirely by MAST.
